mapper.insert: insert into board (board_id, category, title, content, member_no, reg_date) values (#{board_id},#{category},#{title},#{content},#{member_no},sysdate)
mapper.select: select nvl(count(*),0) from board where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'

select * from ( select rownum rnum, data.* from( select board_id, category, title, content, member_no, reg_date from board where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' order by board_id desc) data)
where rnum>=#{start} and rnum<=#{end}
mapper.update: update board set board_id=#{board_id}, category=#{category}, title=#{title}, content=#{content}, member_no=#{member_no} where board_id=#{board_id}
